framings.text:
I I see all the books I've read this year in one place with a short note on what I thought of each one, This year, before December.
Why: I usually forget what I read by december.
Must: The books I've read this year are included.
Must: Each book has a short note on what I thought of it.
Must not: It must not be fancy.

sources.text: I want a way to keep track of the books I've read this year. I usually forget what I read by december. it would be nice to see them all in one place with a short note on what I thought of each one. nothing fancy.
